# ReservoirWeightSparsity

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deliberate structuring of reservoir connections to be sparse, reducing computational and memory overhead while maintaining dynamical richness. Enables scalable deployment of reservoir computing on topology-centric hardware with limited connectivity resources.
